blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist’s position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture. Besides, we propose a novel framerate-aware multi-dataset training strategy for sequential pose refinement. Our fully integrated approach achieves at most 37.1% superiority in CS-MJE over SOTA on HO3D. Project page: https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT .
blocks.zh: 。 。 。 。 以单光学RGB为基础的手作姿势估计已成为计算机视觉中的一个关键研究前沿。 当地手提出估计方法,预测手相对于手腕的手势,而全球手提出估计也要求估计手腕在相机坐标系统中的位置. 然而,这种相机-相机空间估计面临着两个根本性的挑战:(1) 单相机环境下的深度模糊;(2) 手局部的组合效应和视角预测中的全球腕部位置. 特别是,这种耦合反应出,预测是由局部手姿,手腕姿势和相机所固有的相机共同决定的. 为了克服这些挑战,我们的框架提出了两项关键创新: " 转型-异形主义监督 " ,用于手取深度信息; " 视角信息嵌入 " ,用于解决局部姿势和手腕位置的以上耦合效应,两者都纳入主流编码-解码器架构。 此外,我们提出新的框架-认识多数据集培训战略,以便不断完善。 我们的完全一体化方法在CS-MJE比HO3D上的SOTA达到最多37.1%的优势. 项目网页:https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Accurate monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation plays a pivotal role for VR/AR systems and Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) applications, by facilitating seamless interaction with virtual objects without additional sensors. As shown in Fig 1 (a), local hand pose estimation methods aim to regress wrist-relative hand poses, whereas camera-space hand pose estimation requires localizing the wrist joint in camera coordinates simultaneously. Camera-space hand pose estimation could provide more comprehensive hand information, therefore becoming the primary focus in our work.

blocks.en: Camera-space hand pose estimation faces two major challenges. First, inherent depth ambiguity in monocular views arises when objects of varying sizes at different distances yield identical projections, which is a common limitation in hand pose estimation. Local hand pose estimation methods try to estimate accurate hand size by introducing prior information ( Romero et al., 2017 ; Spurr et al., 2022 ) . However, predicting camera-space hand pose not only requires accurate estimation of hand size, but also depth inference based on that size estimation ( Leonardis et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2023 ) . This imposes stricter requirements on the model’s ability to perceive depth.
blocks.zh: 相机空间手进行估计面临两大挑战。 首先,单相距不同大小的物体产生相同的预测时,就会产生内在的深度模糊,这是手作估计的一个共同限制。 本地手提出估算方法试图通过引入先前的信息来估算准确的手大小(Romero等,2017;Spurr等,2022.). 然而,预测相机-空间手不仅需要准确估计手相大小,还需要根据这种大小估计进行深度推断(Leonardis等,2025;Huang等,2023)。 这对该模型的深度感知能力提出了更严格的要求。

blocks.en: The second challenge is the irreducible coupling result of wrist positions and local hand poses under perspective projection, we claimed it as “perspective coupling effect”. As shown in Fig. 1 (b), orthographic projection precludes perspective effects, thereby rendering the influences of local pose and root joint position mutually independent in the projected result. Consequently, the root joint’s x , y x,y coordinates and local orientation can be directly inferred from the image, as illustrated in (i) and (ii). In contrast, perspective projection entangles root position and local pose, both contributing to the 2D hand orientation in the projection. This coupling makes it impossible to determine the relative contribution of each factor from the image alone, thereby complicating pose estimation. An extreme example is shown in (iv): three distinct combinations of local pose and root joint position produce identical 2D hand projections.
blocks.zh: 第二个挑战是手腕姿势和当地手造成的不可减少的接合结果,我们称这是“可能的接合效应”。 如图1(b)所显示,正图投影排除了视角效应,从而使局部姿势和根相接位置的影响在预测结果中相互独立. 因此,根接点的x、yxy坐标和局部取向可以直接从图像中推断,如(一)和(二)所示。 相形之下,视角投影会缠绕起根位和局部姿势,两者都有助于投影中的2D手取向. 这种组合使得无法单独从图像中确定每个因素的相干作用,从而使平面估计复杂化. 一个极端的例子表现在(四):当地姿势和根相接位置的三个不同组合产生相同的2D手势预测.

blocks.en: Perspective effects are therefore indispensable in camera-space pose estimation. Accurate recovery necessitates explicit modeling of camera intrinsics and perspective geometry. Most existing approaches ( Oh et al., 2023 ; Potamias et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2023 ; Pavlakos et al., 2024 ) either overlook this requirement entirely or rely on virtual intrinsic assumptions; even the latter typically restrict such assumptions to auxiliary 2D projection loss computation, thereby introducing systematic errors into camera-space estimation. For full theoretical analysis please refer to Appendix.
blocks.zh: 因此,在相机空间中,视角效应是不可或缺的。 准确的恢复需要对相机的内在和视角几何进行明确的建模. 大多数现有办法(Oh等人,2023年;Potamias等人,2024年;Xu等人,2023年;Fu等人,2023年;Pavlakos等人,2024年)要么完全忽略了这一要求,要么依赖虚拟内在假设;即使后者也通常将这些假设限制在辅助2D预测损失计算中,从而在相机空间估计中引入了系统性错误. 关于完整的理论分析,请参见附录.

blocks.zh: 图 2. 说明我们的直观基线。 收割图像(# 1) 被视为直接用相机指向手取取取(# 2). 然后将所预测的假人姿势进行旋转以与收成的实际位置相匹配,给出了实际姿势的预测.

blocks.en: To address the aforementioned challenges, the model must (1) sensitively incorporate hand priors to extract depth information from hand images and (2) precisely perceive perspective information of the hand projection. For the first requirement, inspired by ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , we propose Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision (TIS), which aligns the scale and depth information through “rotation” & “scaling” in the latent space to enhance the perception of them for the backbone. For the second requirement, the Perspective Information Embedding (PIE) mechanism is inserted, enabling the ability of perspective information awareness by decorating the image latent patches with perspective vector. The significance of PIE is demonstrated through our carefully designed baseline ( Fig. 2 ), which builds upon the observations in Fig. 1 (b,iv) by first predicting a canonical dummy pose and then applying view-specific transformations to match the input image perspective. In addition, we propose framerate-aware multi-dataset approach to train our model on multiple datasets with various capture configurations, improving training data adaptability and pose estimation accuracy. In conclusion, our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了应对上述挑战,模型必须(1) 敏感地纳入手前科,从手头图像中提取深度信息;和(2) 精确地理解手头投影的视角信息。 关于第一项要求(Ren等人,2025年),我们提议进行转型 -- -- 异形主义监督(TIS),通过在潜在空间的“旋转”和“伸缩”来协调规模和深度信息,以加强对支柱的认识。 对于第二项要求,插入了透视信息嵌入(PIE)机制,通过用透视向量来装饰图像潜在补丁来使透视信息意识的能力得以实现. PIE的意义通过我们精心设计的基线(图2)得到证明,该基线基于图1 (b,iv)中的观测结果,首先预测出一个犬形假人姿势,然后应用特定视线的转换来配合输入图像视角. 此外,我们提议采用帧率-认识多数据集方法,以各种捕获配置的多数据集培训我们的模型,提高培训数据的可适应性并提升估算准确性。 最后,我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: (1) The concept of perspective coupling effect is formalized, with qualitative visualization and theoretical analysis of its impact on hand pose estimation. (2) Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision (TIS): A training component that improves the ability to perceive depth information and alleviates the ambiguity of depth. (3) Perspective Information Embedding (PIE): A mechanism that helps the model to perceive the perspective information and to model the coupling of perspective on hand pose in the latent space. (4) Framerate-Aware Multi-Dataset Training (MDT): This mechanism supports joint training across datasets with varying framerate, improving the performance of our pose estimation network.
blocks.zh: (1)视角耦合效应的概念被正规化,其质量可视化及其对手所产生影响的理论分析提出了估计. (2) 转型-异态主义监督(TIS): 培训部分可提高了解深度信息的能力并减轻深度模糊性。 (3) 视角信息嵌入(PIE): 一种有助于模型理解视角信息并模拟当前视角在潜在空间中的组合的机制。 (4)框架速率-软件多数据集培训(MDT): 这一机制支持不同帧率的数据集之间的联合培训,改善我们定位估计网络的绩效。

blocks.en: By integrating the TIS and PIE mechanisms, we achieve accurate camera-space hand pose estimation, demonstrating 7.8% improvement over state-of-the-art methods ( Leonardis et al., 2025 ) on the HO3D dataset. This performance gain further expands to around 37.1% when incorporating the framerate-aware multi-dataset training mechanism.

blocks.en: 2.1. Local hand pose estimation
blocks.zh: 2.1. 当地人员作出估计

blocks.en: In recent years, research has been devoted to hand pose estimation, especially predicting local hand poses from monocular RGB-based image or sequence ( Contributors, 2020 ; Lugaresi et al., 2019 ; Xu et al., 2022a ; Xu et al., 2022b ; Hampali et al., 2022 ; Tu et al., 2023 ; Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Meng et al., 2022 ; Moon, 2023 ; Oh et al., 2023 ; Prakash et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Spurr et al., 2022 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 近年来,专门研究了手作平面估计,特别是预测由单体RGB成像或序列构成的局部手作平面(贡献者,2020;Lugaresi等,2019;许等,2022a; 徐等,2022b;汉帕利等,2022;图等,2023;帕夫拉科斯等,2024;孟等,2022;月球等,2022; 2023; Oh等,2023; Prakash等,2024;Lin等,2024;Spurr等,2022;Zhao等,2025;

blocks.en: Among various architectures, transformer-based models outperform others for its high accuracy and robustness ( Potamias et al., 2025 ; Pavlakos et al., 2024 ) against other architectures like CNN ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Lugaresi et al., 2019 ; Hampali et al., 2020 ) or graph-CNN ( Ge et al., 2019 ) . It has been proven that scaling laws ( Kaplan et al., 2020 ) still roughly hold in this field.
blocks.zh: 在各种建筑中,变压器模型的精度和稳健性都高于其他建筑(Potamias等,2025;Pavlakos等,2024;与CNN等建筑(周等,2024;Lugaresi等,2019;Hampali等,2020)或图-CNN等建筑相对. (Ge等,2019). 事实证明,在这方面,比例法(Kaplan等人,2020年)仍然大致有效。

blocks.en: Figure 3. Method illustration. (i) In single-frame training, an off-the-shelf detector localizes the hand, then Perspective Information Embedding (PIE) enhances latent feature with camera intrinsics and detection boxes. The spatial module extracts pose features, which are mapped to pose parameter by the Pose Decoder. Transformation Isomorphism Supervision (TIS) transforms patches and compares decoded poses with GT, imposing depth information into latent space. (ii) Temporal Module is added after the spatial module to exploit the temporal cues. We design the zero-init linear layer for training efficiency. The TIS mechanism is omitted in temporal training stage.
blocks.zh: 图 3. 方法说明。 (一) 在单帧训练中,一个现成的探测器将手定位,然后Perspect Information Embedding(PIE)用相机的内在和探测箱来增强潜在特性. 空间舱取出物呈现出特征,由Pose Decoder来映射出出参数. 变形异形监督(TIS)会将补丁和被解码的外观与GT相提并论,将深度信息强加于潜在的空间. (二) 在空间单元后增加时间模块,以利用时间提示。 我们设计出0-init线性层来提高训练效率. 在时间培训阶段省略了技术信息系统机制。

blocks.en: Specialized designs have also been proposed to resolve the inherent challenges of hand pose estimation: occlusion, self-occlusion and motion blur. H2ONet ( Xu et al., 2023 ) proposed learning occlusion information for hand-object interaction via dual-branch encoder. Deformer ( Fu et al., 2023 ) proposed a dynamic fusion transformer for temporal pose modeling to address motion blur. By incorporating vision transformer with large scale of data, HaMeR ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ) achieves impressive accuracy and robustness in local hand pose estimation. Based on that, WiLoR ( Potamias et al., 2024 ) advances multi-hand localization and estimation with the novel image-aligned multi-scale sampling and a dataset including 2M+ in-the-wild images.
blocks.zh: 还提出了专门设计,以解决手作估计的内在挑战:隔离、自闭和运动模糊。 H2ONet(Xu等,2023年)提议通过双分支编码器来进行手-对象相互作用的学习隐蔽信息. Deformer (Fu等, 2023年)提出一个动态聚变器,用于时间姿势模型,以解决运动模糊. HaMeR(Pavlakos等,2024年)通过将视变器与大规模数据相接而来,实现了令人印象深刻的准确性和强健性,在本地手上提出了估算. 在此基础上,WiLOR(Potamias等,2024年)以新颖的图像相通多尺度采样和包含2M+内相成像的数据集推进多手本地化和估计.

blocks.en: Though lots of works with various architectures emerged to tackle the challenges in this field, few works provide solutions for global localization of hand in the camera space, leaving a substantial space for our work.
blocks.zh: 虽然出现了许多与各种架构合作的作品来应对这一领域的挑战,但很少有作品为照相机空间中的手全球本地化提供解决方案,为我们的工作留下了相当大的空间。

blocks.en: 2.2. Hand pose estimation in camera space
blocks.zh: 2.2. 手在相机空间作出估计

blocks.en: Camera-space and global hand pose estimation has drawn the attention of cutting-edge research. This distinct task focuses on estimating the pose of hand, including the position relative to camera. Recent studies ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) integrate local hand pose estimation methods ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ; Potamias et al., 2025 ) with SLAM-based camera tracking, enabling continuous hand pose tracking in world coordinates. We categorize them as global hand pose estimation.
blocks.zh: 相机空间和全球手表估计引起了尖端研究的注意。 这一不同的任务侧重于估计手的姿势,包括相对于相机的位置. 最近的研究(Yu等,2024;Zhang等,2025)将本地手作姿势估计方法(Pavlakos等,2024;Potamias等,2025)与基于SLAM相机的相机跟踪相结合,使得能够连续地在世界坐标上手作姿势跟踪. 我们把它们归类为全球手作估计。

blocks.en: For camera coordinate-based estimation, recent approaches address this challenge through novel paradigms. Huang et al. ( Huang et al., 2023 ) propose a Neural Voting Field (NVF) that projects 2D features into 3D voxels to predict joint-wise voting preferences, thereby locating hand joints in camera coordinates. This projection mechanism circumvents coupling challenges via voxel representation and reprojection. However, their approach predicts the joint’s position instead of rotation due to the voxel restriction, limiting the applicability. Valassakis et al. ( Leonardis et al., 2025 ) introduce HandDGP, which established differentiable PnP solutions for derivable 2D-3D lifting. Their PnP algorithm bridges the “local to camera-space” estimation in learnable approach. However, they neglect the perspective coupling effect, resulting in accuracy degradation compared to our method, as shown in our experiment at Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh: 就以相机坐标为基础的估计而言,最近的方法通过新的范式来应对这一挑战。 黄等. (Huang等,2023年)提出神经投票场(NVF),将2D特征投入3D voxels,以预测联想投票偏好,从而将手接头定位于相机坐标. 这种投影机制通过阴道表示和再投影绕过耦合挑战. 然而,他们的做法预测联合体的地位,而不是由于排毒的限制而轮换,从而限制了适用性。 瓦拉萨基斯等. (Leonardis等,2025年)引入了HandDGP,它为可衍生出2D-3D升起确定了可分化的PnP解决方案. 他们的PnP算法将可学习方法中的“局部到相机空间”估计相接。 然而,正如我们在Tab的实验所示,它们忽略了视角耦合效应,导致与我们的方法相比的精度退化。 1 (英语).

blocks.en: 2.3. Representation Learning for hand pose estimation
blocks.zh: 2.3. 学习手表估计

blocks.en: Some studies employ representation learning to enhance pose estimation methods. The goal of representation learning is to learn representations beneficial for downstream tasks, thereby improving both the performance of training and inference. As categorized by ( Singh et al., 2024 ) , representation learning comprises two paradigms: MIM-based methods reconstruct images to learn representations ( He et al., 2021 ) , while contrastive-based methods leverage positive-negative sample pairs for loss-driven representation learning ( Chen et al., 2020a ) .
blocks.zh: 有些研究利用代表性学习来改进估计方法。 代表性学习的目标是学习有益于下游任务的代表性,从而改善培训和推论的绩效. 如(Singh等人,2024年)所分类,代表性学习包括两个范式:基于MIM的方法重建图像以学习代表性(He等人,2021年),而基于对比性的方法则为损失驱动的代表性学习利用正负对(Chen等人,2020年a).

blocks.en: Most representation learning frameworks for hand pose estimation employ contrastive-based methods. For example, SiMHand ( Lin et al., 2025 ) constructs positive sample pairs by identifying images with similar poses via 2D pose detectors to enhance robustness against texture/lighting factors. We argue this is essentially knowledge distillation from 2D pose estimators. PeCLR ( Spurr et al., 2022 ) adapts SimCLR ( Chen et al., 2020b ) framework by introducing geometric transformations to feature maps. This method directly applies a geometric inverse transformation in the image space to 2D feature maps, thereby directly constraining strong geometric priors in the latent space. We express concern about the practice of directly injecting intuitive constraints into the latent space. Similarly, ( Ren et al., 2025 ) also argues that such an approach can be further improved. Inspired by this, we propose Transformation-Isomorphic Supervision (TIS) to learn pose-enriched representations through parametric mappings isomorphic to geometry transformations across image and 3D domains.

blocks.en: 3.3. Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision
blocks.zh: 3.3. 转型-异形主义监督

blocks.en:
Transformation Isomorphism Supervision (TIS) stems from a fundamental geometric insight about perspective projection systems.
This insight asserts a one-to-one correspondence between scale-rotation transformations in the 2D space and those in the 3D pose space. Specifically, if a transformation is applied to a 2D projection result, a corresponding transformation can be applied to its 3D position such that the new 2D result remains the same as the projection of new 3D position, as shown in Fig. 5 .
A formal specification of these scale-rotation transformations is detailed in the Appendix.
This phenomenon is attributed to the intrinsic nature of hand geometry and the principles of perspective projection. The interplay between these two factors establishes a consistent relationship of depth variations across 2D and 3D spaces.

blocks.en: 3.4. Framerate-Aware Multi-Dataset Training
blocks.zh: 3.4. 框架速率-智能多数据集培训

blocks.en: Large scale annotated data and temporal information fusion is vital for accurate global hand pose estimation. Incorporating multiple public datasets can solve the first problem, but also introduces the second problem: the capture configuration varies across datasets, especially the framerate. We propose our framerate-aware multi-dataset training (shortened as MDT ) approach supporting different framerate in temporal training scenario.
blocks.zh: 大规模附加说明的数据和时间信息聚合对于准确的全球手提出估计至关重要。 纳入多个公共数据集可以解决第一个问题,但也引入了第二个问题:捕获配置因数据集而异,特别是帧率. 我们建议采用框架-认识多数据集培训(缩短为MDT)办法,支持在时间培训情况下采用不同的框架。

In the original RoPE mechanism, the rotation angle θ \theta of the embedding is determined solely by the token’s index i i . In our proposed TI-RoPE, we replace this with the corresponding timestamp τ i \tau_{i} of each token’s position, thereby making the encoding sensitive to framerate variations.

blocks.en: 4.1. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1. 详细执行情况

blocks.en: We use Swin-Transformer ( Liu et al., 2022 ) with “base” scale as our vision backbone. The input image is fixed to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , producing images patches in { P 1 , ⋯ , P 64 } ∈ ℝ 64 × 768 \{P_{1},\cdots,P_{64}\}\in\mathbb{R}^{64\times 768} . For each of L = 6 L=6 spatial modules, the standard self-attention module is implemented, with head number and hidden dimension equal to the configuration of backbone. The detailed architecture about spatial module can be found in Fig. 4 . The perspective information embedding module is a 3-layer MLP. The s ​ r latent sr_{\text{latent}} is composed of 2 standard self-attention layers. For temporal module, three individual branches with 2 cross-attention layers are inserted for pose, shape and translation.

blocks.en: To further validate effectiveness against current SOTA of local pose estimation, we compare with HaMeR ( Pavlakos et al., 2024 ) , the work incorporating a large amount of data and huge parameters (ViT-H). Since HaMeR predicts poses in local coordinates, we apply Perspective- n n -Point (PnP) post-processing to lift predictions to camera space for equitable evaluation. Even though our model and data are not comparable in scale to HaMeR, we still conducted experiments to demonstrate our method’s hand geometry modeling capability in camera-space pose estimation. HaMeR is compared with the MDT setup in the following analysis.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步确证当地估计的SOTA的有效性,我们与HaMeR(Pavlakos等人,2024年)进行了比较,后者包含了大量数据和巨大的参数(ViT-H)。 由于HaMER预测了本地坐标,我们应用了Perspect-n-Point(PnP)后处理,将预测提升到相机空间进行公平评价. 尽管我们的模型和数据在尺度上与HaMER不相上下,但我们仍进行了实验,以展示我们方法在相机空间的手相几何模型能力,从而作出估计。 以下分析将HaMER与MDT设置进行比较.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 1 , the proposed method achieves superior CS-MJE, RS-MJE, and RTE, with only marginally higher PA-MJE. This pattern stems from fundamental differences in handling perspective distortion: the proposed method explicitly encodes intrinsics and perspective effects, enabling disentanglement of global position and local pose that are coupled under perspective projection. This yields accurate camera-space localization (lower CS-MJE and RTE) and refined local pose estimation (lower RS-MJE).
blocks.zh: 如图一所示,拟议方法实现了CS-MJE、RS-MJE和RTE的优越性,PA-MJE只有略高。 这种模式源于在处理视角扭曲方面的根本差异:拟议方法明确编码内在因素和视角效应,使全球位置和局部位置得以分解,在视角预测下加以组合。 这产生精确相机-空间本地化(更低的CS-MJE和RTE)并被精炼出局部的姿势估计(更低的RS-MJE).

blocks.en: The relative disadvantage in PA-MJE arises from a limitation of the metric itself rather than estimation quality. PA-MJE applies Procrustes alignment between predictions and ground truth, which compensates for local pose errors caused by perspective coupling. Consequently, HaMeR benefits from this alignment-based error cancellation, whereas our method—already accounting for perspective effects via explicit intrinsics—gains no such artificial advantage.

blocks.en: To isolate architectural contributions from model capacity effects, we trained a ViT-B variant of HaMeR (matching our backbone scale). blocks.en: We proposed a novel approach for accurate hand pose estimation in camera space. This method can enhance the quality of existing interaction devices by providing pose with respective to camera. Further works on effectively utilizing distortion information and temporal clues are under investigation.

blocks.en: FreiHAND is a large-scale, single-image 3D hand pose and shape estimation benchmark. It contains over 130,000 training frames, each providing accurate ground truth 3D hand joint annotations (21 keypoints) and MANO shape parameters. The dataset was captured using a multi-view green-screen setup, enabling easy background augmentation and robust training. It has become a standard benchmark for evaluating 3D hand reconstruction from a single RGB image.

blocks.en: After this transformation, the resulting image is analogous to one captured by a telephoto lens, exhibiting diminished perspective distortion and more closely approximating an orthographic projection. Moreover, in telephoto scenarios, estimating camera intrinsic parameters is more challenging. This is because variations in object distance produce only subtle changes in projection size. This effect, compounded by factors such as camera shake and defocus during capture, typically exacerbates errors in depth perception. For a machine learning model, this means it is highly prone to overfitting to the dataset’s specific characteristics, rendering it unable to accurately estimate the 3D hand pose in camera space.
blocks.zh: 这一转变之后,所产生的图像类似于被遥光镜头所摄取的图像,其视角扭曲减少并更近似于正图投影. 此外,在远程摄影情景中,估计相机内在参数更具挑战性. 这是因为物体距离的变化只产生投影大小的微妙变化. 这种效应,加上相机摇晃和捕捉时分心等因素,一般会加剧深度感知出错. 对于机器学习模型来说,这意味着它极易与数据集的具体特性相过于相适应,使其无法准确估计相机空间中3D手姿.

blocks.en: We trained our model on FreiHAND and plotted the CS-MJE, RTE, RS-MJE and PA-MJE of test set for each epoch, the results are shown in Fig. 12 . We observed that the metrics reflecting local hand pose estimation (RS-MJE and PA-MJE) decreased and converged to reasonable levels during training. However, the camera-space hand pose estimation metrics (CS-MJE and RTE) continuously oscillated at a high error level. By comparison, we can determine that the main source of this error is root joint localization, as the RTE metric remained persistently high. Conversely, Fig. 13 shows that the CS-MJE on the training set does decrease, converging to below 30 mm. This divergence from the test set performance confirms that the model has overfit on the global pose estimation task, which validates our theory.
blocks.zh: 我们在FreiHAND上训练了我们的模型,并绘制了每个时代的CS-MJE,RTE,RS-MJE和PA-MJE测试集,结果见图12。 我们注意到,反映当地手势的衡量标准(RS-MJE和PA-MJE)在培训期间有所减少并趋于合理水平。 然而相机-相机-相机-相机-相机手呈现出在高误差水平上持续偏振的估算度量(CS-MJE和RTE). 相较之下,我们可以确定这个错误的主要来源是根联合本地化,因为RTE的度量一直很高. 反之,图13显示,训练集上的CS-MJE确实减少,汇合到30毫米以下。 与测试集性能的这种差异证实了该模型对全球姿势估计任务过于适应,这证实了我们的理论.

blocks.en:
We analyze the PnP post-processing used to lift HaMeR predictions into camera space on the HO3D evaluation set. Root-PnP recovers the camera-space root position by estimating only a global translation ( t x , t y , t z ) (t_{x},t_{y},t_{z}) , while retaining HaMeR’s predicted global orientation and MANO-derived hand scale.
The translation is obtained by minimizing the 2D reprojection error over all 21 joint correspondences. In contrast, Full-PnP jointly estimates global rotation and translation. Both variants use HaMeR-predicted 2D
correspondences, HO3D ground-truth camera intrinsics, and GT-derived hand bounding boxes.

翻译是通过将所有21个联合信件的2D再预测出错最小化而获得的. 相形之下,Full-PnP联合估算出全球旋转和翻译. 两个变体都使用HaMeR预想的2D

blocks.en: Directly utilizing the estimated root joint position for rendering imposes stricter requirements on pose estimation accuracy, as the model must accurately localize the hand root joint within a vast free space to produce sufficiently accurate rendering results. In contrast, the root-joint alignment operation completely eliminates the difficulties arising from such high degrees of freedom, allowing the model to focus solely on local accuracy. Nevertheless, even when facing such challenges, our model can achieve higher pre-alignment accuracy than post-alignment accuracy in certain scenarios. This is because when root joint estimation is sufficiently accurate, the perspective coupling effect becomes pronounced. Our model pursues overall pose estimation accuracy in camera space (CS-MJE), whereas root joint alignment inadvertently increases error accumulation at distal joints. This characteristic enables our model to achieve more accurate estimation precision for joints that are more frequently involved in interactions, such as fingertips. blocks.en: From the perspective of the Jacobian matrix, depth ambiguity is manifested in equation eq. 26 as the symmetry of the additive structure. The complete 2 × 6 2\times 6 Jacobian matrix shows complete symmetry between local pose J rel , i J_{\text{rel},i} and global translation t t in terms of projection change rates. blocks.en: G.4. Perspective Information Loss and Coupling Effect Analysis
blocks.zh: G.4. 前景信息损失和连带效应分析

blocks.en: Based on the analysis of the complete Jacobian matrix, this section explores the perspective information loss caused by cropping operations and its interaction with the perspective coupling effect. In practical applications, hand pose estimation typically first obtains a hand bounding box through a detector, then crops and scales the region within the bounding box as input to the network. This preprocessing step simplifies the input but introduces the problem of perspective information loss.
blocks.zh: 基于对完整的雅各布斯矩阵的分析,本节探讨收割作业造成的视角信息损失及其与视角耦合效应的相互作用. 在实际应用中,手作估计一般首先通过探测器获得一个手接框,然后在接框内种植并缩小区域,作为对网络的投入。 这个预处理步骤简化了输入,但引入了视角信息丢失的问题.

blocks.en: In the original image, the position and size of the hand contain rich perspective geometric information—the farther the hand is from the camera, the smaller the image size, and the projection process is closer to the orthogonal projection. From an information-theoretic perspective, cropping reduces the amount of information for depth estimation. In the original image, the hand position ( u 0 , v 0 ) (u_{0},v_{0}) and size s 0 s_{0} provide strong cues about depth t z t_{z} : according to perspective projection, size s 0 ∝ 1 / t z s_{0}\propto 1/t_{z} . After cropping, these cues are partially removed, increasing the uncertainty of depth estimation.

blocks.en: The perspective information loss caused by cropping exacerbates the perspective coupling effect. After losing the original position information, the network can only infer global position from the content of the cropped image, and must rely on indirect cues in the image content, which are often ambiguous and unreliable.
blocks.zh: 收成导致的视角信息损失会加剧视角相接效应. 失去原始位置信息后,网络只能从被收割的图像内容中推断出全球位置,必须在图像内容中依赖间接提示,这些提示往往模糊不清,不可靠.
